mechanism: Guanfacine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that can cause hypertension when combined with phenelzine (MAOI), which inhibits catecholamine metabolism, leading to excessive sympathomimetic stimulation and potential hypertensive crisis.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use with extreme caution, baseline and frequent blood pressure monitoring, and consider alternative agents such as SSRIs or non-MAOI antidepressants.
